content: Insperity, Inc. amended its credit agreement with ZB, N.A. dba Amegy Bank on February 6, 2018, increasing the revolving credit facility to $350 million with an option to raise it to $400 million. The swing line loan and letter of credit subfacilities were raised to $30 million each. The agreement, which matures on February 6, 2023, is secured by 65% of the stock of the company’s captive insurance subsidiary and guaranteed by all domestic subsidiaries. Interest rates depend on the leverage ratio, with margins ranging from 1.50% to 2.25% for LIBOR loans and 0.00% to 0.50% for alternate base rate loans. The alternate base rate is defined as the highest of the prime rate, federal funds rate plus 0.50%, or the bank’s prime rate. The agreement includes financial covenants limiting the company’s minimum interest coverage ratio and maximum leverage ratio. The document was referenced in Exhibit 10.1 to the Form 8-K filing and included in the press release issued on February 12, 2018, signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel and Secretary.
